title: Zelophehad's Daughters

questions.question: Who asked Moses for an inheritance because their father had no sons?
questions.explanation: Numbers 27:1-4 (ESV): "Then drew near the daughters of Zelophehad... Give us a possession among our father's brothers."

questions.question: What was their father Zelophehad's status regarding Korah?
options: He was not in the company of Korah; he died for his own sin
He was a leader of the rebellion
questions.correctAnswer: He was not in the company of Korah; he died for his own sin
questions.explanation: Numbers 27:3 (ESV): "He was not in the company of those who gathered themselves against the Lord in the company of Korah... died for his own sin."

questions.question: What was the Lord's ruling on their request?
options: "The daughters of Zelophehad are right. You shall give them possession of an inheritance."
questions.correctAnswer: "The daughters of Zelophehad are right. You shall give them possession of an inheritance."
questions.explanation: Numbers 27:7 (ESV): "The daughters of Zelophehad are right. You shall give them possession..."

questions.question: If a man has no son, daughter, or brother, to whom does the inheritance go?
questions.explanation: Numbers 27:10 (ESV): "And if he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father's brothers."

questions.question: If even his father has no brothers, where does it go?
options: The nearest kinsman of his clan
questions.correctAnswer: The nearest kinsman of his clan
questions.explanation: Numbers 27:11 (ESV): "Then you shall give his inheritance to the nearest kinsman of his clan..."

questions.question: Where did God tell Moses to go to see the land?
questions.explanation: Numbers 27:12 (ESV): "Go up into this mountain of Abarim and see the land..."

questions.question: Why was Moses not allowed to enter the land?
options: Because he rebelled against God's command in the Wilderness of Zin (Meribah)
questions.correctAnswer: Because he rebelled against God's command in the Wilderness of Zin (Meribah)
questions.explanation: Numbers 27:14 (ESV): "Because you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin..."

questions.question: Who did Moses ask God to appoint?
options: A man over the congregation who shall go out before them
questions.correctAnswer: A man over the congregation who shall go out before them
questions.explanation: Numbers 27:16-17 (ESV): "Let the Lord... appoint a man over the congregation who shall go out before them..."

questions.question: Who did God choose to succeed Moses?
questions.explanation: Numbers 27:18 (ESV): "Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit..."

questions.question: What was Moses to do to Joshua?
options: Lay his hand on him and invest him with some of his authority
questions.correctAnswer: Lay his hand on him and invest him with some of his authority
questions.explanation: Numbers 27:18-20 (ESV): "Lay your hand on him... Invest him with some of your authority..."

questions.question: How was Joshua to inquire of the Lord?
options: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim
questions.correctAnswer: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim
questions.explanation: Numbers 27:21 (ESV): "And he shall stand before Eleazar... who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim..."

questions.question: What metaphor did Moses use for the congregation without a leader?
questions.explanation: Numbers 27:17 (ESV): "That the congregation of the Lord may not be as sheep that have no shepherd."

questions.question: What are the names of Zelophehad's daughters?
options: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah
questions.correctAnswer: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah
questions.explanation: Numbers 27:1 (ESV): "The names of his daughters were: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah."

questions.question: Did Moses obey God regarding Joshua immediately?
options: Yes, he did as the Lord commanded him
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, he did as the Lord commanded him
questions.explanation: Numbers 27:22 (ESV): "And Moses did as the Lord commanded him."

questions.question: Where was this command given (to see the land)?
questions.explanation: Numbers 27:12 mentions Abarim; context is after the plague in Moab plains.

key_verse_text: Who shall go out before them and come in before them, who shall lead them out and bring them in, that the congregation of the Lord may not be as sheep that have no shepherd.
